title: Cloud Warehouses vs Lakehouses: One Key Idea

scenes.line1: Why do modern platforms split storage?
scenes.say: Have you noticed that cloud warehouses and lakehouses split storage from compute? Why is that such a game changer?

scenes.label: Storage
scenes.sub: Data stays safe and persistent, even if compute stops.
scenes.say: First, storage is where your data lives. It’s always available, even if you turn off your compute clusters.

scenes.label: Compute
scenes.sub: Compute clusters process queries, can be scaled or paused.
scenes.say: Compute is all about processing. You can scale up, scale down, or pause it whenever you want, without touching your data.
Before, you paid for everything, even when idle. Now, you only pay for compute when you need it. Storage costs are separate and predictable.

scenes.question: Is compute always needed to store data?
scenes.right: No, storage persists independently. Compute is only needed for processing.
scenes.say: Here’s a common trap: people think compute must run to keep data safe. Actually, storage is independent. Compute is just for processing.
